description: Loop guard: nudge first, escalate at 2x the limit, and no-op empty/unchanged todo lists (design B1 + B2; plan.md items 16-19). In the W3 incident, update_todo_list.todos arrived as an array (fixed by FEAT-001 coercion). The tool then approved an empty list, and the repetition detector asked mistake_limit_reached on the 4th identical call. This feature changes ToolRepetitionDetector to return a nudge at count >= limit and askUser at count >= 2*limit, adds formatResponse.toolRepetitionNudge, and wires the presenter. The nudge records recordToolError(telemetryToolName, 'repetition_nudge'), pushes the nudge error, makes no ask, does not increment consecutiveMistakeCount, and does NOT set didToolFailInCurrentTurn. Non-worker escalation is unchanged; worker escalation calls failParallelWorker with no ask. It also adds the ordered B2 table in UpdateTodoListTool.execute. Row 1 ('just prose') ALSO sets didToolFailInCurrentTurn = true per round-3 NIT 5. Depends on FEAT-001 (hoisted telemetryToolName, presenter try/catch, coerceTodosArg/todosString) and FEAT-003 (Task.failParallelWorker).
steps: plan.md item 16: in src/core/tools/ToolRepetitionDetector.ts export type ToolRepetitionCheckResult as a union whose non-matching members declare `nudge?: undefined; askUser?: undefined` (keeps existing result.askUser accesses typechecking). Keep the counting. When limit > 0 && count >= 2*limit, reset the counters and return askUser (messageKey 'mistake_limit_reached', today's messageDetail). Else when limit > 0 && count >= limit, return { allowExecution: false, nudge: { toolName, repeatCount: count } } keeping the counters. Else return allowExecution true. Rewrite src/core/tools/__tests__/ToolRepetitionDetector.spec.ts expectations per plan.md item 16 (limit 3: calls 4/5/6 nudge, 7 askUser then reset; limit 1: 2 nudge, 3 askUser; limit 2: 3 nudge, 5 askUser; 0/negative never block), adding no new `any`.

plan.md item 17: in src/core/prompts/responses.ts add toolRepetitionNudge(toolName, repeatCount) returning `You already called ${toolName} with identical arguments ${repeatCount + 1} times in a row; this call was not executed. Do not call it again with the same arguments. Proceed with the next action of your task.` and, for update_todo_list, the extra sentence ` Only call update_todo_list again after an item's status changes.`

plan.md item 17: in src/core/assistant-message/presentAssistantMessage.ts replace the repetition block (inside FEAT-001's try). For nudge: recordToolError(telemetryToolName, 'repetition_nudge'); pushToolResult(formatResponse.toolError(formatResponse.toolRepetitionNudge(block.name, repeatCount))); break (no ask, no mistake++, no didToolFailInCurrentTurn). For askUser on a worker: the existing two telemetry calls, pushToolResult(formatResponse.toolError(`Tool call repetition limit reached for ${block.name}. Please try a different approach.`)), await cline.failParallelWorker(t('tools:toolRepetitionLimitReached', { toolName: block.name })), break. For askUser on a non-worker: the existing code, unchanged.

plan.md item 17 test: create src/core/assistant-message/__tests__/presentAssistantMessage-repetition.spec.ts (no `any`). Copy the vi.mock preamble of presentAssistantMessage-custom-tool.spec.ts and build a typed task double cast once with a comment. Cases: nudge pushes one 'this call was not executed' result, makes no ask, does not run the tool, and keeps didToolFailInCurrentTurn false; a custom-tool nudge records recordToolError('custom_tool', 'repetition_nudge'); non-worker escalation asks mistake_limit_reached; worker escalation calls failParallelWorker, makes no ask, and pushes one error result.

plan.md item 18: in src/core/tools/UpdateTodoListTool.ts execute, after validateTodos and the normalizedTodos map and BEFORE approvalMsg/approvedTodoList = cloneDeep (~45-56), evaluate the ordered rows with trimmed = todosString.trim(), isJsonShaped = trimmed starts with '[' or '{', and current = task.todoList ?? []. Row 1: trimmed !== '' && !isJsonShaped && normalizedTodos.length === 0 -> mistake++, recordToolError('update_todo_list'), didToolFailInCurrentTurn = true (NIT 5), toolError('No checklist items found. Provide the full list as `[ ] item` lines.'). Row 2: the ordered (content, status) pairs equal current (including both empty) -> toolResult(`Todo list unchanged (${n} items, ${m} completed). Do not call update_todo_list again until an item's status changes; proceed with the next action.`). Row 3: normalizedTodos empty and current non-empty -> toolResult(`Todo list unchanged: an empty list was ignored. Current list has ${n} items (${m} completed). Proceed with the next item; do not call update_todo_list again until an item's status changes.`). Row 4: the existing approval flow. No-op rows never touch consecutiveMistakeCount, todoList or approvedTodoList.

plan.md item 18 tests in src/core/tools/__tests__/updateTodoListTool.spec.ts: unchanged list -> 'Todo list unchanged (2 items, 1 completed)' with askApproval not called; '' / '[]' / '{"todos":[]}' / array [] -> row 2 with an empty current list and row 3 with a non-empty one, with no mistake increment and no failure flag; 'just prose' -> row 1 error, consecutiveMistakeCount 1, didToolFailInCurrentTurn true, recordToolError('update_todo_list'); '[1,2]' -> row 2/3 (the Markdown path returns []); a changed list keeps the approval/user-edit flow (the existing 2 cases still pass).

findings:
ToolRepetitionDetector.ts exports `type ToolRepetitionCheckResult`, a 3-member union per D5. Counting is unchanged. It escalates first (`limit > 0 && count >= 2 * limit`: reset the counters, return askUser mistake_limit_reached with today's messageDetail). Otherwise it nudges (`count >= limit`: `{ allowExecution: false, nudge: { toolName, repeatCount: count } }`, counters kept). With the default limit 3, calls 4/5/6 nudge (repeatCount 3/4/5), call 7 escalates, and call 8 starts a fresh streak.
responses.ts: `formatResponse.toolRepetitionNudge(toolName, repeatCount)` uses the plan text with `repeatCount + 1`, plus the extra update_todo_list sentence.
presentAssistantMessage.ts, inside FEAT-001's dispatch try: (1) `if (repetitionCheck.nudge)` -> `cline.recordToolError(telemetryToolName, "repetition_nudge")`, pushToolResult(toolError(toolRepetitionNudge(...))), break. No ask, no consecutiveMistakeCount++, no didToolFailInCurrentTurn. (2) `if (repetitionCheck.askUser)`: the two existing telemetry calls are now a local `captureRepetitionTelemetry()` closure, and the limit error string is a local `repetitionLimitError`. For a worker: telemetry, pushToolResult(repetitionLimitError) FIRST, then `await cline.failParallelWorker(t("tools:toolRepetitionLimitReached", { toolName: block.name }))`, break. For a non-worker: same ask / user_feedback / telemetry / pushToolResult sequence as before (behavior unchanged). The old `!allowExecution && askUser` guard became `askUser` (the union makes it equivalent).
UpdateTodoListTool.execute: the B2 rows sit after the normalizedTodos map and before approvalMsg / `approvedTodoList = cloneDeep`. `trimmed` uses `typeof todosString === "string" ? todosString.trim() : ""`, because the FEAT-001 typeof check is inside a nested try and TS does not carry the narrowing out (non-strings already returned through the invalid-checklist branch). Row 1 (prose, no items): mistake++, recordToolError('update_todo_list'), didToolFailInCurrentTurn = true (NIT 5), toolError. Row 2 (same ordered content/status pairs, both-empty included): toolResult 'Todo list unchanged (n items, m completed)...'. Row 3 (empty incoming, non-empty current): toolResult 'Todo list unchanged: an empty list was ignored...'. Row 4: the existing flow. Rows 2/3 do not touch mistakes, todoList or approvedTodoList.
Tests: ToolRepetitionDetector.spec.ts rewritten (23 its). The private-method override now uses bracket notation, so the spec's 3 no-explicit-any suppressions are gone and its eslint-suppressions.json entry was removed (count decrease, normalized with jq -S --tab and committed). New presentAssistantMessage-repetition.spec.ts (4 its, no `any`, typed MockTask cast once): it uses read_file with a mocked ReadFileTool, and the telemetry mock adds captureException. The worker double's failParallelWorker sets abort = true to mirror production. updateTodoListTool.spec.ts gets 13 B2 its: unchanged; it.each over '', '[]', '{"todos":[]}', array [], '[1,2]' against an empty and a non-empty current list; 'just prose' (asserts didToolFailInCurrentTurn true, mistake 1, recordToolError); and a changed list that runs approval.
